shared_elements: dense field of hieroglyph-like sign blocks
glyph blocks arranged in a grid of rows and columns
square/rounded cartouche-shaped signs with internal detail (faces, dots, bars)
low-relief carving covering the whole surface with no figural scene
justification: Both surfaces are covered entirely by a grid of squarish glyph cartouches, each packed with internal head-like and dot/bar elements, carved in shallow relief and organised in paired columns/rows with no accompanying figural imagery — a highly specific and conventional writing-block scheme unlikely to arise independently. The main difference is the format of the support (a tall narrow column of glyphs versus a broad low boulder with longer horizontal rows) and slightly bolder, more rounded modelling on A, but the depicted content is of the same kind.
